_comment: Inline policy for the per-space instance role ikigenba-space-<domain>. The operator-side tool substitutes four literal placeholders at create time; Terraform never reads this file. A space has one identifier: its full domain, <domain> (for example foo.sbx.ikigenba.dev, or the account domain itself for the apex space). It must end in the `domain` property at /ikigenba/account. That one value is the SSM path segment (/ikigenba/<domain>/*), the bucket prefix (<domain>/), the role name suffix, and the two DNS names the space owns, <domain> and *.<domain>. <zone_id> is the hosted zone found by longest-suffix match of <domain> over the account's hosted zones. <account_id> is the account the space is created in. <bucket> is the account's backup bucket, the `backup_bucket` property at /ikigenba/account; the role's permissions boundary ARN is the `permissions_boundary_arn` property there. The boundary is the ceiling: nothing granted here can exceed it.
